description: Take raw customer inputs — interview transcripts, survey responses, Slack quotes, support tickets, review excerpts — and generate a structured case study draft with problem/solution/result narrative, pull-quotes, metric callouts, and multi-format outputs (full case study, one-pager, social proof snippet, sales deck slide). Pure reasoning skill. Use when a product marketing team has customer signal but no time to write the story.
